indicator_contract.slowk: TA-Lib STOCH high/low/close: fastk5, slowk3 SMA(mat0), slowd3 SMA(mat0); use slowk (lookback8)
indicator_contract.rsi: TA-Lib RSI(close,14), compatibility0 and unstable period0; lookback14
indicator_contract.bb_lower: typical=(high+low+close)/3; rolling20 min_periods1 mean minus2*sample_std(ddof1); first bar NaN
indicator_contract.hammer: TA-Lib CDLHAMMER(open,high,low,close) default candle settings from frozen TA-Lib C binary; lookback11; exact100 required
indicator_contract.entry: rsi<30 AND slowk<20 AND bb_lower>close AND CDLHAMMER==100
indicator_contract.missing: NaN comparison false; no fills, no interpolation
indicator_contract.volume: No source signal volume clause added; real input quality must reject nonpositive volume independently
indicator_contract.warmup: All8928 December2023 native5m bars preceding evaluation; compute continuous indicators without resetting Jan1; startup_candle_count source absent, reference default0; no warmup trading or inherited pending orders
indicator_contract.signal_collision: Keep both booleans; simultaneous entry/exit suppresses signal entry/exit but not risk. With RSI<30 and monotonic Fisher>.3 this is logically impossible for a consistent same-bar RSI except implementation errors.

runtime_resolution.reference_scope: default precedence and indicator references only; never treated as original author runtime

execution_plan.signal_order_timing: At evaluation bar k open, use completed bar k-delay_bars; source signal index must be within evaluation. Base earliest2024-01-01T00:05Z; delay2 earliest00:10Z.
execution_plan.limit_quote: fixed close of signal bar k-delay_bars; no repricing
execution_plan.timeout: pending order survives only current5m observed bar; cancel next open (300seconds), terminal cancellation at end; no implicit rehang absent newly selected delayed signal
execution_plan.fill: Full fill at touch inclusive; buy if low<=limit, sell if high>=limit under chosen path. Favorable marketable open applies2bps adverse slip capped to limit. Intrabar limit fill exact limit. No queue/partial-fill model.
execution_plan.market_stop: 2bps adverse below triggered market reference, including gaps
execution_plan.reservation: deduct only on fill, budget95% of available cash including fee; no borrowing, no multiple open orders
execution_plan.samebar_path: deterministic diagnostic O-L-H-C, not a conservative bound or a claim of native Freqtrade matching
execution_plan.priority: Marketable open entry first; then open stop gap before signal limit before ROI. Ascending segment earliest touched signal/ROI limit, ties signal first. Descending segment market stop first encountered. Newly filled entry sees remaining path only; no same-bar reentry after exit.
execution_plan.timestamp_precision: Open a bar proxy; intrabar exact time null with bar-open/close interval bounds, no invented path-segment timestamps
execution_plan.terminal: mark final bar close, no forced sale or hypothetical exit fee

risk_plan.stop_level: entry_fill*.9 fixed, may gap through; fees/slippage additional
risk_plan.trailing_note: Never activate or update trailing; positive/offset attributes are inert.
risk_plan.profit_gate: At execution bar open before placing an indicator SELL limit, compute quote*(1-exit_fee)/(entry_fill*(1+entry_fee))-1. Require strict>0. quote=observed bar open, fee rate from current case, not raw price appreciation. Initial buy cost denominator includes entry fee.
risk_plan.profit_gate_timing: Check once at order decision, not signal generation and not retrospectively at fill. No order on failed gate. Passing order remains live for one bar without rechecking. Slippage/pricing movement may still produce a net-losing signal fill; this is not silently prevented.
risk_plan.profit_gate_scope: indicator exit only; never blocks stoploss or ROI
risk_plan.roi_clock: floor elapsed wall-clock minutes from fill open; intrabar fill age origin conservatively bar-close+1ms. Choose active tier at each next open and hold for that bar; no lower tier from future intrabar time.
risk_plan.roi_price: entry_fill*(1+entry_fee)*(1+roi)/(1-exit_fee), treated as limit; exact threshold inclusive in this diagnostic plan, a declared engine assumption
risk_plan.source_framework_priority_difference: Reference lists signal then stop then ROI; this plan uses explicit path/open-stop-first. Therefore HYPOTHESIS, not strict reproduction.
